bullets.text: CityFibre's Growth Ambitions - CityFibre's new CEO aims for expansion through altnet consolidation to meet customer demand.
UK MNOs Eye mmWave Spectrum - Ofcom approves UK MNOs for upcoming mmWave spectrum auction, promising enhanced connectivity.
Transforming Telecom Customer Experience - Telecoms shift focus from metrics to real-time, personalized customer engagement strategies.
Medusa Cable Expands Connectivity - The Medusa submarine cable begins its rollout, linking Southern Europe and North Africa.
Orange Business Enhances Crisis Comms - Orange integrates OneWeb satellite services into its emergency connectivity solution.
Verizon's New Leadership - Ex-PayPal CEO Daniel Schulman takes over as Verizon's CEO, aiming for market share growth.
Private 5G Revolution at Airbus - Airbus partners with **Ericsson** to deploy a private 5G network for smart factory operations.
Huawei's AI and 5G-A Integration - **Huawei** emphasizes the convergence of AI and 5G-A to reshape telecom operator value.
